T3. Long-term development [YES] — Neutral expert verdict due July 2027; ongoing India-Pakistan water dispute trajectory

Synopsis:
The Permanent Court of Arbitration ruled that India must continue honoring the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty with Pakistan, which India suspended in April 2025 following a deadly Kashmir attack. The court also ordered India to halt construction of the Ratle hydroelectric dam wall and power intake structure above specified levels until 90 days after a World Bank-appointed neutral expert rules (by July 2027). India flatly rejected the verdict, denying the court's jurisdiction. The dispute centers on water access critical to 80% of Pakistani farmland and India's hydroelectric ambitions in Kashmir.
